title: Whirlpool India jumps 12% on promoter exit talk

timeline.title: Whirlpool India jumps 12% on promoter exit talk
timeline.line: Parent explores selling its remaining 39.76% stake as a control deal; stock hit ₹959.60
more: Whirlpool Mauritius is in talks with more than one potential buyer
Whirlpool of India says it is not part of the negotiations and does not know the terms
About ₹987 cr of shares traded on NSE, a sharp volume spike
